translation.Usage logs are kept permanently for audi: Usage logs are kept permanently for auditing and cannot be deleted.
translation.The upstream returned a model name diffe: The upstream returned a model name different from both the requested and upstream models. Aliases or dated versions may also cause this; this warning alone does not prove model substitution.
translation.Optional for nap_ access tokens; require: Optional for nap_ access tokens; required for legacy system access tokens.
translation.Only needed when the upstream supports f: Only needed when the upstream supports fewer endpoints than the channel type. When set, it replaces the automatic list.
translation.Fixed by the built-in route preset of th: Fixed by the built-in route preset of this channel type.
translation.Determined by the Advanced Custom routes: Determined by the Advanced Custom routes. Requests for other endpoints are not routed to this channel.
translation.Custom channels without relay routes acc: Custom channels without relay routes accept every endpoint. Add Advanced Custom routes to restrict them.
translation.Automatic list for this channel type; re: Automatic list for this channel type; replaced by the manual override below.
translation.Derived automatically from the channel t: Derived automatically from the channel type. Requests for other endpoints are routed to other channels.
translation.Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages: Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages are also accepted when the global Chat→Responses policy covers this channel.
translation.Each route declares an inbound endpoint: Each route declares an inbound endpoint this channel accepts and how it is forwarded upstream. Requests for endpoints without a route are sent to other channels.
translation.Fix the JSON before switching to the vis: Fix the JSON before switching to the visual editor
translation.No relay routes yet. Without routes this: No relay routes yet. Without routes this Custom channel forwards everything to its Base URL.
translation.Optional. Used for fetching the model li: Optional. Used for fetching the model list and querying balance; they do not accept relay requests.
translation.A path joined to the Base URL, or a full: A path joined to the Base URL, or a full URL. {model} is replaced with the upstream model name.
translation.Empty = all models of this channel: Empty = all models of this channel
translation.Comma separated; prefix re: for a regula: Comma separated; prefix re: for a regular expression. A route for all models must come after model-specific routes of the same endpoint.
translation.Forward the client request body unchange: Forward the client request body unchanged for this route. Model mapping, parameter overrides and field filtering are skipped.
